---
title: "Installation"
---

## Requirements

- Linux, Python ≥ 3.11.
- [Quarto](https://quarto.org) to render reports (PDF through Typst, bundled with Quarto, or
  LaTeX/TinyTeX).
- A terminal text editor for scripts: `nano` (default) or `vi`.
- For the AI assistant: an API key (Claude, ChatGPT) or a local [Ollama](https://ollama.com)
  server.

## Install

```bash
cd onthesignal
python3 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/pip install -e .            # core
.venv/bin/pip install -e ".[ai]"      # + AI providers (anthropic, openai, ollama)
.venv/bin/pip install -e ".[dev,docs]" # + tests and documentation tools
```

The `onthesignal` command is then available in `.venv/bin/`.

## First launch

```bash
.venv/bin/onthesignal                     # empty console
.venv/bin/onthesignal data/*.mseed        # console with files loaded as S1, S2...
.venv/bin/onthesignal --version
```

Type `/` to open the command menu, `/help` for the list, `/quit` (or Ctrl+D) to leave.
